name: Theramore Medal
summary: At Northwatch Hold, Theramore Medal marks service among the marines and officers defending the outpost along the Merchant Coast. The insignia bears Theramore’s mark and identifies the Alliance garrison.

sections.title: Tokens of Northwatch
sections.body: Marines, marksmen, commandos, and officers serving from Northwatch Hold carry stamped medals bearing Theramore’s mark. The soldiers are loyal to Lady Jaina Proudmoore’s realm. For the human troops on the cliffs above the Barrens, the medals show that their service is legitimate and their authority comes from Theramore. Others see the tokens as trophies from an overzealous foreign garrison, one that treats every vessel approaching the coast as a mortal threat.

sections.title: Pirate Vengeance
sections.body: Northwatch Hold’s gun batteries menace ships along the Merchant Coast, often bombarding privateers and merchantmen alike. After losing ships to the guns, Ratchet privateer Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun seeks the medals. He wants proof that Northwatch’s trigger-happy ranks have paid in blood for sinking his ships, and that the soldiers responsible have been slain in retribution.

faq.answer: A Theramore Medal is an insignia carried by Theramore military personnel serving at Northwatch Hold. It identifies the bearer as an active marine, sailor, or officer in the Alliance garrison in the Barrens.

aliases: where do theramore medals come from
faq.answer: Marines, sharpshooters, deck hands, commandos, senior cannoneers, and officers serving at Northwatch Hold carry these medals along the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: Why does Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun want them?
faq.answer: Northwatch Hold’s artillery has bombarded passing ships, including vessels belonging to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun’s fleet. He demands the medals as proof that the soldiers responsible have been slain in retribution.

faq.q: Why is Northwatch Hold attacking passing ships?
faq.answer: Northwatch Hold’s garrison is paranoid on the edge of Horde territory. Its cannoneers have grown reckless and trigger-happy, firing on nearly any vessel that approaches their coastal enclave.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists, medals of Theramore gathered as blood bounties show how isolated and aggressive Northwatch Hold has become on Kalimdor’s frontier.
For Horde adventurers, these medals are proof of the growing Alliance military presence on the shores of the Barrens.
